designationHistory.indexText: Choctaw National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1964 on land acquired for the Army Corps of Engineers' Coffeeville Lock and Dam project on the Tombigbee River, managed by the Fish and Wildlife Service under a perpetual lease.

authority.citation: Lease agreement with the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Choctaw NWR Comprehensive Conservation Plan, 2006 (ServCat 167939)
